title: Fix install.ps1 aborting on the first missing dependency (#1)
paragraphs: install.ps1 runs with $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'. On Windows PowerShell, assigning a native command's output to a variable under that preference turns an expected nonzero exit (a "not installed yet" probe) into a terminating error, even with stderr redirected to $null. Every check in deps.ps1 (insightface, onnxruntime, opencv) follows that probe pattern, so install.ps1 aborted at the very first one on any machine where insightface wasn't already installed - i.e. every fresh install. Reproduced on a clean Windows ARM64 VM.

deps.ps1 now sets its own 'Continue' preference so these expected probe failures don't propagate as terminating errors regardless of the caller's preference. Also switched the bare `pip install` calls to `python -m pip install`, matching this repo's own convention so packages land in the interpreter that gets checked, and added exit code checks so a real pip failure (e.g. no prebuilt wheel for the platform) is reported instead of silently ignored.
Added tests/deps.Tests.ps1, which reproduces the abort against the old script and passes against the fix, and wired it into CI.

title: Mac: Electrobun launchers (3d-viewer, face-swap, img-gen); install_mac --with-bun-install
paragraphs:
- POSIX scripts mirror VBS env (GLB_FILE, TARGET_IMAGE, FOLDER_PATH, .env) and build-on-first-run.
- install_mac.sh links the three commands; --with-bun-install|-B runs bun install in every tools/*/ package.json tree.
- AGENTS file tree notes install_mac.sh and Electrobun folders.

title: feat(face-swap): Add support for video face swapping
paragraphs:
Updates the face-swap tool to support swapping faces in video files.
- Adds `process_video` to the python backend to handle frame-by-frame swapping and audio muxing via ffmpeg.
- Updates the UI to allow dropping video files and displaying video previews.
- Updates the backend to handle video file paths and serve the resulting mp4.

title: Add local face swap desktop tool and finish the integration.
paragraphs: This adds a drag-and-drop InsightFace face swap app with Explorer integration, docs, site metadata, and generated artwork so it feels like a finished tool. It also fixes the Electrobun first-paint sizing bug in the image windows so they open at the correct size.
